gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans has huge lowercase eyes and tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe. Ubuntu Sans keeps that friendly plumbing look going line after line, while Outrun Future's wide-set synthwave capitals handle the shouting.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-vend-sans: Wide-set, synthwave and outlined with a steady line, Outrun Future leads, while Vend Sans follows with ruler-straight strokes and open curve endings. They fit like a neon sign over a plain wall.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi has an e that opens clearly to the right and lowercase letters built on outsized proportions. Yaldevi is the pair's anchor, giving the fixed-nib, wide-spaced Outrun Future a body that stays easy and open beneath it.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-orbit: Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, military and spaced out, commanding from the first line. And Orbit follows with rope-like stems and curves that stop short, each character floating apart, so the pair feels airy but disciplined.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, with stroke ends set far apart. Over There earns its place on big, short lines, where its fixed-nib, vintage-military capitals and generous white space can command attention without crowding anything.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-syncopate: Drawn with a fixed-width nib and plenty of white space between glyphs, Over There carries a vintage-military command. Syncopate answers with open c, e and s shapes and a technical-pen steadiness, so the heading's swagger gets a tidy, rung-like rhythm beneath it.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-abeezee: Heavy and bold, Plakkaat bends its lines like a straw and curls terminals nearly back to the stem. And ABeeZee opens its endings well clear, so the heading can be large while the text stays smaller.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-aldrich: Plakkaat looks bent from one thick wire, with terminals that curl nearly shut against the stem, heavy and bold. Aldrich's cupped round letters answer that with open shapes; make its size modest.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-alexandria: Alexandria is clean and tall in the body, with wide open terminals. Plakkaat sits beside it like a heavy bent-wire sign next to a lighter, more spacious companion, closed shapes against open ones.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-amiko: Plakkaat is bent-wire heavy, with low contrast and terminals that curl almost shut against the stem. And Amiko's strokes, thick as crayon marks, flick outward like tongs, giving the dense heading an open, modern partner.
